invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Shared secrets MUST be >=160 bits drawn from a CSPRNG; the verifier REJECTS secrets shorter than 20 bytes and NEVER transmits secret material outside the enrollment channel.
verify() MUST compare codes in constant time via hmac.compare_digest and SHALL NEVER short-circuit on prefix match.
Accepted clock skew MUST be bounded to +/-1 step (+/-30s); larger windows CANNOT be configured through the public surface.
A successfully used step number MUST be recorded and the same step CANNOT be accepted again for the same secret; replay attempts SHALL be rejected.
Codes SHALL be six decimal digits derived from HMAC-SHA1 per RFC 4226; alternative digit counts MUST be explicitly opted in via allow_nonstandard_digits=True.
